title: Exelon (EXC) Study Warns Northern Illinois Could Face Nearly Double Severe Rainfall
summary: Exelon (NasdaqGS:EXC) subsidiary ComEd and Argonne National Laboratory released a joint climate study for northern Illinois in 2026. The report projects almost double the number of severe rainfall events in northern Illinois by around mid century compared with today. Findings point to higher risks for Exelon's grid assets from flooding, ice storms, and shifting soil conditions in the region.
